title: STNFS v13 + recentred kernels, f-first ECM, weight-200 merge, ten LA owners: 121.038

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the complete STNFS algorithm in proof.md and DESCENT.md with the REFINEMENT.md refinements, 99.9% ECM, X2 = 2^64, theta = 2881/8000 collection on a 150,000-draw pool (proof.md), the measured record route, the re-measured recentred slice12 kernel table (KERNELS.md), f-first cofactorisation with early abort, the weight-200 merge and the STORAGE.md/row_tail.c kernels with ten active owners returns Q satisfying e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P, with success at least 0.395702 (and hence at least 0.39) under disclosed heuristics H1-H5 (with H4u: at least 88% of the filtered matrix row weight is +-1 entries, measured at weight 100 and 200; the weight-200 ratio N(200)/N(100) <= 0.80 is part of H3). It computes two GT logarithms and returns Q=[a]Q0, handling z=1 directly. All classical work is bounded by a global meter at 2^121.038 dense-Fp12 units, C=20,000 instructions, with upper-rounded ledger rows summing to <= 2^121.038 (2^121.0379932). ECM succeeds with 99.9% per prime; X2 = 2^64; theta=2881/8000 (6628 rows, a-radius 869) with slacks (295, 226), allowance 1.0263, alpha (5.15, 0.85), primes in [2^63, 2^64) charged twice, records routed at 10.01 each and re-read at 7.003; the g-side ECM runs only after the f side factors, charged with probability q_f = 100 rho(u_f)/P(omitted_f <= slack_f) per row: collection <= 2^120.8661 units (charged mean 391.6 instructions per cell). The polynomials, factor-base bound, filtering, kernels and target remain those of the cited source; the 62-node descent plan of REFINEMENT.md/refinement.json (coordinate search with joint moves, 35 entries differ from the base plan, boot unchanged) is evaluated at UDUP = 0.65 and THIN_MAX 85. Linear algebra (STORAGE.md, row_tail.c: mean weight 201 after merging to weight 200, 20.7 instructions per sparse entry, 1,640 per row for the ten-owner six-limb transfers, combination and the reduction mod r, 97 per dense term, 420 per further 9-limb reduction, N = 0.80 x 1.096 x 0.0471 U = 2^58.8539 < 10 x 2^56, Block Wiedemann blocks (19, 4)) is <= 2^117.2274 units, generator <= 2^106.6814. Descent credits UDUP = 0.65 distinct relations per raw relation (relation-weighted E[shat/m]/pr >= 1.06 boot / >= 4.70 nodes, uniform cells), forces discard only up to 2^90, and keeps 18 boot relations. Expected two-log work is bounded by 2^115.697; the two-log meter is 2^116.43; Markov abort probability is <= 0.6016516. Other upper bounds are boot failure 3.600e-04 per log, expected nodes 2^17.74, node abort 2^-9.56 and repeats 2^-10.70, with 2/r statistical distance charged. All preprocessing, failed attempts, advice, arithmetic, transfers, sorting, verification and output are included; nothing amortized. Numerical-certificate construction receives an extra 2^50-unit allowance. Memory is at most 2^105 bytes. Source smoothness and production extrapolations stay explicit heuristics. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Bounded audit of recorded full-recurrence evidence, upward-rounded ledger and success, unchanged prime-window endpoints, and nonzero lower/upper integration controls. Does not rerun the full recurrence.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py) to mean weight 100 or 200 (default 200) and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.88) and U/N. Optional (the hosted initial run is the bounded audit). Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).

Optional full recomputation of certificates, region, ledger (recentred kernels, early abort, weight-200 LA, ten-owner row tail with owner_schedule check), retention, ECM, descent and declared bounds (about 125 s natively; longer when emulated).
